## Trend Monitoring Notes (2026-03-30)

### High-Potential Emerging Topics for Future Scripts
1. **"AI-proof your career"** — Gen Z fears AI displacement; framework content performing well
2. **"Loud quitting"** — Counter to "quiet quitting" trend; performative exit content
3. **"Slop internet aesthetic"** — Anti-AI content niche growing; authenticity signals
4. **"Career ladder vs career lattice"** — Non-linear career paths; Gen Z resonance
5. **"Soft life professional"** — Work-life boundary framing; intersectional content

### TikTok Algorithm Signals to Watch
- First 3 seconds: must hook with relatable pain point or contrarian statement
- Watch-through rate: scripts with "problem → framework → resolution" structure outperforming pure advice
- Comment bait: "the thing nobody tells you" framing drives high engagement
